x: The Suez Canal is an artificial sea-level waterway located in Isthmus of Suez in Egypt. It is 193.30 km long. This canal connects the Mediterranean Sea and the Red Sea. It became operational in 1869. Tewfik Port (Suez Port) is located to the south of Suez Canal and Port Said is located to its north. It is the largest artificial navigational canal in the world. s: Consider the following statements: Statement-I: Sumed pipeline is a strategic route for Persian Gulf oil and natural gas shipments to Europe. Statement-II: Sumed pipeline connects the Red Sea with the Mediterranean Sea. Which one of the following is correct in respect of the above statements?
o: Both Statement-I and Statement-II are correct and
Both Statement-I and Statement-II are correct, but
Statement-I is correct, but Statement-II is incorrect
Statement-I is incorrect, but Statement-II is correct
x: The Sumed pipeline (also known as the Suez-Mediterranean pipeline) is an oil pipeline in Egypt, running from the Ain Sokhna terminal in the Gulf of Suez, the northernmost terminus of the Red Sea, to offshore Sidi Kerir port, Alexandria in the Mediterranean Sea. It provides an alternative to the Suez Canal for transporting oil from the Persian Gulf region to the Mediterranean. The Suez Canal and the Sumed pipeline are strategic routes for Persian Gulf crude oil, petroleum products, and liquefied natural gas (LNG) shipments to Europe and North America. The Suez Canal and Sumed pipeline are both located in Egypt and connect the Red Sea with the Mediterranean Sea. Hence, both Statement-I and Statement-II are correct, and Statement-II explains Statement-I. So, option (a) is the correct answer. However, it is to be noted that Sumed pipeline is an oil pipeline which transports crude oil only (not natural gas). So, in literal terms, Statement-I could be incorrect and in that case option (d) will be the correct answer.

x: Visakhapatnam is AP's only major port; Krishnapatnam, Kakinada and Gangavaram are non-major ports.

s: Visakhapatnam Port handled a record cargo of about how much in 2025-26?
x: Visakhapatnam handled a record 91.17 MMT in 2025-26, up from 82.62 MMT in 2024-25.

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about Visakhapatnam Port?
o: It is the only major port of AP
It is 2nd among east-coast major ports
It ranks 1st among all major ports
It handled a record 91.17 MMT in 2025-26
x: Visakhapatnam is 4th among major ports and 2nd on the east coast, not first overall.

s: What is the length of the coastline of Andhra Pradesh?
x: Andhra Pradesh has a coastline of about 1,053 km.

s: The AP Retail Trade Policy 2015–20 targeted how many additional retail jobs by 2020?
x: The policy targeted 20,000 additional jobs in the retail sector by 2020.

s: Which of the following is an objective of the Andhra Pradesh Export Promotion Policy (APEX) 2022–27?
o: Integrated export ecosystems from districts to ports
x: APEX 2022–27 promotes global market access, logistics, competitiveness and integrated district-to-port export ecosystems.

s: What export target does AP's Industrial Development Policy 4.0 (2024-29) set?
x: The policy targets US$ 40 billion exports, along with Rs 30 lakh crore investment and 175+ industrial parks.

s: Which organisation is building the Dugarajapatnam shipbuilding cluster under the Andhra Pradesh Maritime Policy?
x: The special purpose vehicle NSHIP-AP Ltd is building the Dugarajapatnam shipbuilding cluster.

s: The Dugarajapatnam shipbuilding cluster under AP's Maritime Policy aims at what share of national capacity by 2047?
x: The cluster built by NSHIP-AP Ltd targets 25% of national shipbuilding capacity by 2047.

s: AP's Industrial Development Policy 4.0 (2024-29) plans how many industrial parks?
x: IDP 4.0 plans 175+ industrial parks, with US$ 40 bn exports and 5 lakh jobs.

s: What investment target does Andhra Pradesh's Industrial Development Policy 4.0 (2024-29) set?
x: IDP 4.0 targets Rs 30 lakh crore investment, 5 lakh jobs and US$ 40 bn exports.

s: Which District Export Hub is correctly matched with its products?
o: Visakhapatnam—marine products, engineering goods and health services
East Godavari—chillies, turmeric and cotton yarn
Guntur—coir products, cashew and nursery plants
Visakhapatnam—coir products, cashew and nursery plants
x: The Phase-I Visakhapatnam District Export Hub covers marine products, engineering goods and health services. East Godavari covers coir, cashew and nursery plants, while Guntur covers chillies, turmeric and cotton yarn.

s: In which year was the Districts as Export Hubs (DEH) initiative launched under the Foreign Trade Policy?
x: DEH was launched in 2019 under the FTP, with DGFT as nodal agency.

s: Which is the nodal agency for the Districts as Export Hubs initiative?
x: DEH, launched in 2019 under the FTP, is run by the DGFT; ODOP was merged into it.

s: Coir, cashew and nursery plants are the DEH Phase-I products of which AP district?
x: East Godavari's products are coir, cashew and nursery plants; Guntur's are chillies, turmeric and cotton yarn.

s: Which of the following is NOT an economically backward area in Andhra Pradesh?
In the Export Preparedness Index 2024, Andhra Pradesh ranked how high among large States?
x: In EPI 2024 (4th edition, released by NITI Aayog in Jan 2026) Andhra Pradesh ranked 5th among large States, after Maharashtra, Tamil Nadu, Gujarat and Uttar Pradesh. Ninth was AP's rank in EPI 2021.

s: Andhra Pradesh ranked ninth in which edition of the Export Preparedness Index?
x: Andhra Pradesh ranked 9th in EPI 2021, the second edition (APPSC-GS 2022 key). In EPI 2024 (4th edition) it ranked 5th among large States.

s: With which institution did NITI Aayog prepare the first Export Preparedness Index (2020)?
x: The first EPI, released in 2020, was prepared by NITI Aayog with the Institute for Competitiveness.

s: In NITI Aayog's Export Preparedness Index 2024, which pillar carries the highest weight of 40%?
x: In EPI 2024, Business Ecosystem carries 40%. Export Infrastructure, Policy and Governance, and Export Performance each carry 20%.

s: In LEADS 2024, Andhra Pradesh was placed in which category?
x: AP was an Achiever in 2022 and 2023, a Fast Mover in 2024 and an Accelerator in LEADS 2025.

s: In LEADS 2025, Andhra Pradesh was ranked in which tier among coastal States?
x: LEADS 2025 has four tiers; AP was an Accelerator among coastal States.

s: Which State topped NITI Aayog's Export Preparedness Index 2024?
x: In EPI 2024 the order was Maharashtra, Tamil Nadu, Gujarat, Uttar Pradesh and Andhra Pradesh.

s: How is a Special Economic Zone treated for trade and tariff purposes?
o: Foreign territory only for income tax
Territory with no special customs treatment
x: An SEZ is treated as foreign territory for trade and tariffs and works through a single-window system.

s: What does the SEZ Act, 2005 seek to do to domestic and foreign investment?
x: Promotion of domestic and foreign investment is an objective of the SEZ Act, along with economic activity, exports, employment and infrastructure.

s: In which year was the SEZ policy announced in India under the EXIM Policy?
x: The SEZ policy was announced in 2000 under the EXIM Policy/Foreign Trade Policy; the SEZ Act followed in 2005.

s: Who can set up an SEZ under the SEZ framework?
o: Only a joint venture of the Centre and a State
The Centre, a State or any person, jointly or severally
x: An SEZ may be established by the Centre, a State or any person, jointly or severally; it is not restricted to government joint ventures.

s: How does an Export Oriented Unit (EOU) differ from an SEZ?
o: A single unit that may be located anywhere under the FTP scheme
A developer-led enclave with its own infrastructure
A demarcated enclave notified under the SEZ Act, 2005
A zone made up of a developer and several units
x: An EOU is a single unit located anywhere under the Foreign Trade Policy scheme; the developer-plus-units enclave belongs to an SEZ.

s: Which body is reviewing the proposal for a dry port at Sri City in Tirupati district?
x: The Sri City dry port proposal in Tirupati district is under review by an Inter-Ministerial Committee.

s: What did the Baba Kalyani Committee (2018) propose to rename Special Economic Zones as?
x: The Baba Kalyani Committee proposed the term “3Es”, meaning Employment and Economic Enclaves, for SEZs.

s: An SEZ proposal goes from the State to which body for approval?
x: SEZ proposals are sent by the State to the Board of Approval.

s: In which year was the Special Economic Zones Act enacted?
x: The SEZ policy came in 2000 under the EXIM Policy; the SEZ Act was passed in 2005.

s: SEZ exports make up about what share of India's exports?
x: SEZ exports of Rs 14.64 lakh crore (about US$ 173 bn) are about 21% of India's exports.

s: In which year was the Export Oriented Unit (EOU) scheme introduced?
x: The EOU scheme came in 1981 under the trade policy; Kandla EPZ was 1965 and the SEZ policy 2000.

s: Out of 19 operational SEZs in Andhra Pradesh the number of Pharmaceutical SEZs are
x: Of the 19 operational SEZs in Andhra Pradesh, 4 were dedicated pharmaceutical SEZs.

s: The Chinese Company that established Special Economic Zone in Nellore District to manufacture shoes is
x: The notes do not cover this fact. Apache, a Taiwanese-origin footwear maker, set up its SEZ at Nellore (Sri Venkateswara SEZ, Ramapuram) to make shoes, so Apache is the answer.

s: Sri City, a multi-product zone with SEZ, DTZ, FTWZ and Electronics Manufacturing Cluster components, is in which district?
x: Sri City is in Tirupati district and combines a multi-product SEZ, DTZ, Free Trade Warehousing Zone and Electronics Manufacturing Cluster.

s: Which one of the following is NOT correctly matched?
x: Kakinada SEZ is located in Kakinada, not Srikakulam district. Pydibhimavaram is the pharma cluster associated with Srikakulam.

s: As of July 2023, how many notified SEZs did Andhra Pradesh have?
x: AP had 32 notified SEZs as of July 2023; 19 refers to operational SEZs around January 2019.

s: How many operational SEZs did Andhra Pradesh have around January 2019?
x: Andhra Pradesh had 19 operational SEZs in the period referred to by the APPSC-GS 2018 key. The notified count in July 2023 was 32.

s: Which is the nodal agency for industrial parks and SEZs in Andhra Pradesh?
x: APIIC is the nodal agency for industrial parks and SEZs in AP and has developed 10 SEZs.

s: Divi's Laboratories, located in the Visakhapatnam region, is associated with which sector?
x: Divi's Laboratories is a pharmaceutical unit in the Visakhapatnam region (with Parawada Pharma City). Apparel is linked to Brandix India Apparel City at Atchutapuram. Electronics manufacturing (Foxconn) is linked to Sri City. Automobiles (Isuzu) are also linked to Sri City.

s: The Pydibhimavaram pharma cluster is in which district?
x: Pydibhimavaram is in Srikakulam; Kakinada SEZ is in Kakinada district.

s: Which of the following SEZ/unit – district pairs is correctly matched?
x: APSEZ is at Atchutapuram-Rambilli in Anakapalli; Kakinada SEZ is in Kakinada, Sri City in Tirupati and Pydibhimavaram in Srikakulam.

s: Brandix Apparel City at Atchutapuram is associated with which sector?
x: Brandix at Atchutapuram is an apparel unit; Foxconn (electronics) and Isuzu (automobiles) are at Sri City.

s: Where is the Isuzu automobile unit in Andhra Pradesh located?
x: Sri City in Tirupati district hosts Isuzu (automobiles) and Foxconn (electronics).

s: In which district is the Jawaharlal Nehru Pharma City at Parawada located?
x: JN Pharma City at Parawada, with units of Divi's, Dr. Reddy's and Aurobindo, is in Anakapalli district.

s: Which is India's first coastal industrial corridor?
x: The Visakhapatnam–Chennai Industrial Corridor (VCIC) is India's first coastal industrial corridor and part of the East Coast Economic Corridor.

s: Under CBIC guidelines, a new dry port is generally not allowed within how many km of a seaport?
x: The CBIC norm bars a new dry port within 200 km of a seaport; 100 km applies to distance from an ICD.

s: Which one of the following pairs is NOT correctly matched?
o: VCIC — Visakhapatnam, Chittoor/Srikalahasti-Yerpedu and Kopparthy nodes
ECEC — Orvakal as its only Andhra Pradesh node
x: Orvakal is the node of HBIC. VCIC is part of the ECEC and has the listed Visakhapatnam, Chittoor/Srikalahasti-Yerpedu and Kopparthy nodes; the statement that ECEC has Orvakal as its only AP node is incorrect.

s: Orvakal in Andhra Pradesh is a node of which industrial corridor?
x: Orvakal is a node of the HBIC, not of the VCIC/ECEC.

s: Which of the following is NOT a node of the Vizag-Chennai Industrial Corridor?
x: VCIC nodes are Visakhapatnam, Srikalahasti-Yerpedu and Kopparthy; Orvakal belongs to the HBIC.

s: Which place in coastal Andhra had the first English factory, set up in 1611?
x: The first English factory in coastal Andhra was at Machilipatnam in 1611. Visakhapatnam, Kakinada and Krishnapatnam are today's port towns, but none of them holds this first.
